'''Volume 1: A Party with Pikachu''' is the first of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
Hazel has fallen desperately in love with the handsome Pokémon trainer{{sic}} Almond. But he doesn't even notice her, so she goes to Grandpa, an old wizard and Pokémon researcher, to get a sure-fire love potion that will make Almond hers! However, love potions come with a price, and Grandpa demands that Hazel go out and capture Pokémon for him. Hazel doesn't know a Pokémon from a poker chip, but for the love of Almond, Hazel is willing to do anything! It's not until she discovers the feisty and cute Pikachu that Hazel begins to understand the magic and charm that makes Almond so enthusiastic about these wonderful creatures.

==Important events==
* [[Hazel]] agrees to collect Pokémon for [[Grandpa]].
* Hazel meets {{MPJ|Pikachu}}, {{MPJ|Clefairy}} and {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}}.
* Hazel and friends celebrate their first Christmas together.
* Hazel and friends meet {{MPJ|Squirtle}}.
* [[Almond]] celebrates his birthday.

==Party changes==
* {{MPJ|Pikachu}} in [[PPP01]].
* {{MPJ|Clefairy}} in [[PPP02]].
* {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}} in [[PPP03]].

==Trivia==
* This volume of Magical Pokémon Journey contains three "Bonus Bonus" chapters:
** Pokémon File!: An overview of each human and Pokémon that has appeared in the manga so far.
** Yumi Tsukirino's Road to Becoming A Pokémon Master!!: A brief interview with Tsukirino that details her experiences with playing [[Pokémon Red and Green Versions|Pokémon Green]].
** Let's Catch Some Pokémon!!: A story in which {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{AP|Pikachu}} stumble into the world of Magical Pokémon Journey, where being a Trainer is unimportant and Pokémon do not like battling.
* At the end of the book, there is a joke advertisement for {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|2}} that teases the arrival of space aliens who seek to take over the world.
